name: Blood Curse of Mutual Suffering
description:
When you or an allied creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a Reaction to link their pain to another. Choose a different creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target of the curse receives half the damage of the same damage type received by the attacked creature.
	**Amplify**: This curse instead deals damage equal to the damage received by the attacked creature, and it counts immunity as resistance.
